name: Rezon
bio: Rezon son of Eliada had fled from his master Hadadezer, king of Zobah, when David defeated Zobah's army, and gathered a band of men around himself. He and his followers went to Damascus, settled there, and Rezon became king over Aram, reigning there as an adversary of Israel throughout Solomon's reign, embittered against Israel alongside Hadad the Edomite — part of the LORD's judgment raised up against Solomon for his unfaithfulness (1 Kings 11:23-25).
